settings.title: How pre-order works
settings.content:
You order now at the pre-order price. The run goes into production, your size is cut with it, and it ships to you first — before the piece reaches the collection pages.

You are charged at checkout, which is what reserves the size. If the run is delayed beyond the date shown, we write to you and you can cancel for a full refund, no questions.

settings.title: When it ships
settings.content:
The dispatch window is shown against each size. Once the run lands in Brisbane, pre-orders go out first, the same afternoon they are picked.

You do not pay duties or taxes. Every international order ships DDP.

settings.title: Exchanges & Returns
settings.content_intl:

Cancel any time before it ships for a full refund.

settings.question: What fits inside?
settings.answer: It is designed to carry the essentials. Dimensions are listed in the product details above.

settings.question: How do I care for it?
settings.answer: Spot clean with a damp cloth and air dry. Keep it away from prolonged direct sunlight.

settings.question: Can I travel with it?
settings.answer: It is built with travel in mind. Check your airline's carry on limits against the dimensions in the product details.

settings.question: What should I pair it with?
settings.answer: The rest of the travel edit. Pack the Luxe Chino and a polo and you are ready.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer:
44 days to decide, starting the day it arrives. Exchanges and returns are free within Australia and New Zealand, returned in the satchel it came in.

Outside Australia and New Zealand you cover the return postage. Duties and taxes are included in every price, so nothing is owed on arrival.

settings.question: When will it arrive?
settings.answer:
This is a pre-order. The run ships in early November 2026, and pre-orders go out first, the same afternoon they are picked. You are charged at checkout, which is what reserves your size.

If the run is delayed beyond that date we write to you, and you can cancel for a full refund.
